_comment: Business facts a non-developer may need to change: prices, hours, address, phone, wellness amenities, and drive times. This file is JSON so Decap CMS can edit it (admin/config.yml -> 'Gym details'). _data/site.js imports it and is still the ONE place templates read from — nothing else in the repo hard-codes a price or an address.

tiers.name: Open Gym
tiers.summary: Facility + wellness center, train on your own.
tiers.altCtaLabel: Or start with a free intro →

tiers.name: Unlimited
tiers.summary: Unlimited coached classes. What most members pick.

tiers.name: Personal Training
tiers.summary: 12 one-on-one sessions plus everything in Unlimited.

visitOptions.name: Free No Sweat Intro
visitOptions.bestFor: You haven't trained this way before, or you're coming back after time off. Thirty minutes with a coach — a tour, your goals, and a clear recommendation. No workout.

visitOptions.name: Drop-In Class
visitOptions.bestFor: One coached class while you're in town, or anyone who's already used their free first class. Wellness center included.

visitOptions.name: Week Pass
visitOptions.bestFor: Seven days of unlimited classes, wellness center, and full facility access. Cheaper than four separate drop-ins.

visitOptions.name: First Class Free
visitOptions.bestFor: Visiting from another CrossFit affiliate and training at Alpine for the first time. One class on us — one use per person.
